result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign, SignWell or DocuSign**, depending on how many contracts you send and how much functionality you need.

My overall recommendation is **Dropbox Sign for straightforward business use**, with SignWell as a strong budget alternative.

## Best e-signature software compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to use and professional.
- Reusable templates and signing workflows.
- Audit trails and document tracking.
- Good for client agreements and employment contracts.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

- Simple, affordable signing.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing reminders and audit reports.
- Free plan for occasional use.

Website: [SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

(Best established platform)

- Widely recognised by customers.
- Advanced signing workflows.
- Extensive business integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Website: [DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales teams)

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Send contracts for electronic signatures.
- Document templates and payment features.
- Useful for managing the sales process.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF integration.
- Good document editing capabilities.
- Professional signing workflows.
- Ideal if you already use Adobe Acrobat.

## My recommendation

| If your business needs... | Choose |
|--------|--------|
| Simple customer contracts | Dropbox Sign |
| Lowest-cost solution | SignWell |
| Professional, recognised signing | DocuSign |
| Proposals and quotes | PandaDoc |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Sign |


## Important if you're operating in Australia

Check that your chosen platform provides\:

- A downloadable audit trail and completion certificate.
- Signer authentication and document integrity.
- Support for Australian electronic-signature requirements.
- Appropriate privacy and data-handling arrangements.

Electronic signatures are generally recognised under Australian law, but certain document types have additional requirements.
